messages.text: Heads up, the nightly backup job for the reporting warehouse failed again last night. Third time this week. Anyone else seeing the alert?
Yeah I got the email at 5:40am. Does this touch anything Ops relies on? We pull settlement reports off that warehouse for the morning ACH reconciliation.
Looking now. Pretty sure the ShareRecon backup step is what's choking. The nightly share/GL recon scripts write a big temp dump and the volume is probably filling up before the snapshot kicks off.
That tracks. The warehouse job log shows a disk space error right after the recon window ends. Is the temp dump supposed to be cleaned up automatically?
It should be, there's a cleanup at the end of the script. But if the CoreBanking extract runs long the cleanup gets skipped. Vendor was slow pulling data on Monday and Wednesday.
Quick risk question: is last night's recon itself trustworthy, or do we need to rerun before I sign off on the GL tie-out today?
Recon completed fine, only the backup after it failed. I'll diff the share totals against CoreBanking this afternoon to be safe and post the result here.
Also, BSAWatch pulls from the same warehouse snapshot for its feeds. If the backup is stale, do we have a gap on the monitoring side? Want to flag it to Compliance if so.
BSAWatch reads live from CoreBanking and ACHHub, not the warehouse snapshot, so monitoring should be fine. I'll confirm with Monica anyway, but I don't expect a gap.
Hector, honestly this keeps me up a little. Those scripts are only in your head. If you're out sick, who fixes this? Can we get a short runbook written?
Fair point, and I agree. I'll write up a runbook covering the cleanup logic and failure modes by next Friday. Amy, can you shadow me on the fix so a second person knows the flow?
Happy to. I'll block an hour with you after lunch and take notes as we go. I can also add a disk usage alert so we catch this before the backup fails.
Great. Plan: expand the temp volume, force the cleanup to run regardless of extract timing, then rerun the backup tonight. I'll update this thread once the rerun succeeds Saturday morning.
